//exclude: The base config excludes 'tests' (the old harness home). Inherited unchanged, that wiped out this config's own include, so `tsc -p jest` type-checked ZERO files while reporting success. An empty array overrides the inherited list; the paths below are what this project deliberately re-checks. The old `legacy/**/*` entry went with the Node `--test` suite (ticket 08): the retired guards it pointed at live on as follow-up tickets under `.scratch/jest-test-migration/issues/`.
//tsx-suites: This config is a NODE program (nodenext, no custom conditions), so React Native's types resolve WITHOUT the `react-native` condition and uniwind's `className` prop does not exist. A `.tsx` suite renders real app screens, so it belongs to the APP program: the root tsconfig (module preserve, customConditions ['react-native']) already type-checks every **/*.tsx including these. Excluding them by pattern keeps them out of the node program instead of weakening either, and keeps the list from growing one file at a time.
